question: How many days of paid bereavement leave do I get?
answer:
Full-time employees are allowed up to 3 days of paid bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member. Immediate family members include a spouse, domestic partner, child, parent, grandparent, and sibling. 

Джерела: [3-12]
expected_answer: Up to 3 paid days for full-time employees.

question: How much vacation does a full-time employee with 4 years of service get?
answer:
A full-time employee with 4 years of service is eligible for 120 hours of paid vacation. 

Джерела: [3-3]

question: How is overtime paid for non-exempt employees?
answer:
Non-exempt employees who work overtime will be compensated at the rate of one and one-half times (1.5) their normal hourly wage for all time worked in excess of 40 hours each week, unless otherwise required by law. Overtime work must have prior management authorization. 

Джерела: [2-6]
expected_answer: 1.5x hourly wage for time over 40 hours/week, with prior management approval.

question: How much does the company pay me while I'm on jury duty?
answer:
The company will compensate you with a fee of $40 or your regular wage (whichever is lower) for the first three (3) days of jury service. Exempt employees will be paid their full salary less jury duty fees for any week in which they performed work for the company and missed work due to jury service.

Джерела: [3-10]
expected_answer: $40 or the regular wage, whichever is lower, for the first 3 days of jury service; exempt employees get full salary less jury fees for weeks in which they also worked.

question: Скільки оплачуваного часу я можу взяти, щоб проголосувати на виборах?
answer:
Ви можете взяти до двох (2) годин оплачуваного часу, якщо у вас немає принаймні чотирьох (4) послідовних вільних годин до або після роботи, поки виборчі дільниці відкриті. Вам потрібно повідомити компанію про ваше бажання взяти час для голосування принаймні за два (2) робочі дні до Дня виборів. 

Джерела: [3-13]
expected_answer: До 2 годин з оплатою на початку або в кінці робочого дня, якщо немає 4 вільних годин поспіль поза роботою, поки працюють дільниці; повідомити компанію щонайменше за 2 робочі дні до виборів.

question: How much holiday pay does a part-time employee receive?
answer:
Part-time employees receive four (4) hours of pay at their regular straight-time rate for holidays. To be eligible, they must be present on the last scheduled day before and the first scheduled day after the holiday. 

Джерела: [3-2]
expected_answer: 4 hours of pay at the regular straight-time rate (full-time employees get 1 day's pay); the employee must work the last scheduled day before and the first scheduled day after the holiday.

question: I work in New York City. How many hours of paid sick leave do I get per year, and does unused time carry over?
answer:
As an employee working in New York City, you receive a grant of 40 hours of paid safe and sick time at the start of employment and each calendar year. Unused sick and safe leave will not carry over to the following calendar year and will not be paid at separation.

Джерела: [3-4]
expected_answer: 40 hours of paid safe and sick time per calendar year; unused time does not carry over and is not paid out at separation.

question: How often are employees paid?
answer:
Employees are paid weekly for all the time worked during the past pay period. 

Джерела: [2-8]
expected_answer: Weekly, for all time worked during the past pay period.
